title: One-step CRISPR-Cas9-mediated knockout of native TCRαβ genes in human T cells using RNA electroporation
protocol: Insert the eSpCas9(1.1) sequence into a pST1 plasmid vector backbone.
Optimize the pST1 vector for in vitro transcription (IVT) of mRNA to produce high amounts of synthetic mRNA.
Include a T7 promoter followed by a 5′ cloning site, Kozak sequence, and SV40 nuclear localization signal in the eSpCas9(1.1) open reading frame.
Add a 32 amino-acid linker after the SV40 NLS.
Follow with the bipartite NLS from nucleoplasmin and a GSG linker.
Include a P2A peptide sequence for co-expression of both eSpCas9(1.1) and EGFP by self-cleavage during translation.
Add an enhanced green fluorescence protein (EGFP) reporter gene to determine transfection efficiency after electroporation.
Design the eSpCas9(1.1)-P2A-EGFP DNA construct plasmid in silico.
Synthesize the plasmid construct and prepare it for cloning.
Optionally, transform the plasmid into supercompetent E. coli bacteria.
Linearize the pST1 eSpCas9(1.1)-P2A-EGFP plasmid.
Clean the DNA bench with DNA Away Surface Decontaminant solution.
Avoid contact of this DNA Away Surface Decontaminant solution with your own plasmid.
Work fast and use DNase-free filter pipette tips to avoid degradation of DNA.
Calculate volumes of plasmid and water needed for digestion reaction.
Homogenize the plasmid DNA.
Short spin the homogenized plasmid DNA tube.
Keep the DNA on ice.
Homogenize the Tango buffer.
Short spin the Tango buffer tube.
Keep the Tango buffer on ice.
Add plasmid DNA to a sterile 1.5-mL microcentrifuge tube.
Add Tango buffer to the tube containing plasmid DNA.
Add LguI (SapI) restriction enzyme to the reaction mixture.
Mix gently by pipetting up and down several times.
Mix the reagents by pipetting up and down.
Spin down the microcentrifuge tube.
Incubate the microcentrifuge tube on a thermoblock for 2 h at 37°C.
Examine the linearized DNA template in a 1% agarose gel electrophoresis to confirm cleavage of the plasmid is complete.
Add 50 μL of 3 M sodium acetate (pH 5.2) to the microcentrifuge tube.
Add 1 mL of absolute ethanol to the microcentrifuge tube.
Mix the solution gently by pipetting.
Incubate the mixture for 16–24 hours at −20°C.
Centrifuge the microcentrifuge tube at 16,100 × g for 15 minutes at 4°C.
Remove the supernatant carefully without disturbing the DNA pellet.
Add 1 mL of 70% ethanol solution to the DNA pellet.
Centrifuge the microcentrifuge tube at 16,100 × g for 15 minutes at 4°C.
Remove the supernatant carefully without disturbing the DNA pellet.
Add 50 μL of nuclease-free distilled water to dissolve the DNA pellet.
Determine the concentration of linearized plasmid DNA with a NanoDrop (Thermo Fisher).
Bring the linearized plasmid DNA to a concentration of 0.5 μg/μL.
Vortex the 10× Reaction buffer and 2× NTP/CAP.
Keep the RNA Polymerase Enzyme Mix on ice.
Work fast and use RNase-free filter pipette tips during assembly.
Assemble the in vitro transcription reaction using the mMESSAGE mMACHINE T7 transcription kit.
Spin all reagents briefly to prevent contamination or loss of reagent.
Assemble the transcription reaction in a sterile 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube at 19°C–22°C.
Gently mix by pipetting and centrifuge briefly.
Incubate the mix for 2 h at 37°C on a thermoblock.
Add 1 μL TURBO DNase per IVT reaction and mix well.
Incubate the solution for 15 min at 37°C on a thermoblock.
Stop the IVT reaction by adding 50 μL of LiCl Precipitation Solution per IVT reaction.
Mix thoroughly and incubate for more than 30 min at −20°C.
Centrifuge the suspension at 16,100 × g for 15 min at 4°C.
Remove the supernatant carefully without disturbing the mRNA pellet.
Wash the mRNA pellet once with 1 mL of 70% ethanol solution and centrifuge at 16,100 × g for 15 min at 4°C.
Do not resuspend the pellet.
Let the pellet dry with the cap open for 2–5 min at 19°C–22°C.
Add 10 μL of nuclease-free distilled water per IVT reaction.
Let the mRNA dissolve in the water at 4°C for ±30 min.
Determine the mRNA concentration on Nanodrop.
Keep the mRNA on ice during measurement.
Bring the concentration of the mRNA to 2 μg/μL.
Aliquot the mRNA in 20 μL per vial.
Freeze the aliquoted mRNA at -80°C.
Thaw cryopreserved human CD8+ T cells in CTL medium and let the cells rest for at least 4 h before activation.
Prepare a 5 μg/mL solution of no azide (NA)/low endotoxin (LE) anti-CD3 antibody in sterile PBS buffer.
Add 50 μL of NA/LE anti-CD3 antibody to 10 mL of PBS buffer and distribute evenly over the surface of a T75 cell culture flask.
Incubate the flask horizontally in a humidified incubator at 37°C and 5% CO2 for 2 h.
Aspirate and discard the NA/LE anti-CD3 antibody solution from the flask.
Wash the anti-CD3 coated T75 cell culture flask with 10 mL of sterile PBS buffer, avoiding contact with the coated surface.
Prepare 20 × 10^6 viable primary CD8+ T cells.
Centrifuge the CD8+ T cells and discard the supernatant.
Add 20 ml complete CTL medium to achieve a cell concentration of 10^6 cells/mL.
Transfer the cells to the anti-CD3 coated T75 cell culture flask.
Add 20 μL NA/LE anti-CD28 antibody to the culture flask.
Tilt the flask gently to homogenize the suspension.
Incubate flasks horizontally in a humidified incubator at 37°C and 5% CO2 for 3 days.
Adjust volumes for 20 × 10^6 primary CD8+ T cells at the beginning of culture.
Prepare EP recovery medium.
Pre-heat 5 mL of EP recovery medium in a 15 mL tube in a 37°C water bath.
Resuspend activated CD8+ T cells by pipetting against the bottom of the T75 flask.
Take 100 μL of resuspended cells to determine cell concentration on an automatic cell counter.
Check cell viability with PI.
Centrifuge CD8+ T cells at 480 × g for 5 min at 19°C–22°C.
Remove supernatant completely.
Wash T cells by adding 10 mL cold serum-free phenol red-free Opti-MEM.
Centrifuge T cells at 480 × g for 5 min at 19°C–22°C.
Remove supernatant completely.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 200 μL cold serum-free phenol red-free Opti-MEM.
Transfer the cell suspension to a sterile RNase-free microcentrifuge tube.
Thaw eSpCas9(1.1)-P2A-EGFP mRNA and TRAC and TRBC sgRNAs on ice or in a lab cooler at 0°C.
Add 10 μg of eSpCas9(1.1)-P2A-EGFP mRNA to the cell suspension (final concentration: 50 μg/mL).
Add 2.5 μg of TRAC sgRNA to the cell suspension.
Add 2.5 μg of TRBC sgRNA to the cell suspension.
Mix gently by pipetting up and down.
Transfer the cell suspension with RNAs to a 4-mm electroporation cuvette.
Set up the electroporation settings for transfection of T cells with RNA in the BioRad Gene Pulser Xcell electroporation system.
Gently shake the cuvette to evenly distribute the cell suspension.
Place the cuvette in the ShockPod cuvette chamber.
Press the pulse button to electroporate the cells.
Transfer the CD8+ T cells immediately to the pre-heated EP recovery medium after electroporation.
Incubate cells in a humidified incubator for at least 2 h at 37°C and 5% CO2.
Centrifuge CD8+ T cells at 480 × g for 5 min at 19°C–22°C after 2 hours.
Remove supernatant completely.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 5 mL of complete CTL medium.
Take 100 μL of electroporated cells and transfer to a polystyrene FACS tube.
Count cells with an automatic cell counter.
Add FACS buffer up to 200 μL to the remaining cell suspension.
Stain cells with 0.5 μL PI and incubate for 1 min at 19°C–22°C.
Measure cell viability on a flow cytometer.
Bring cell concentration to 0.3–1 × 10^6 cells/mL with complete CTL medium in a T75 flask.
Keep the flask in a humidified incubator for 72 h at 37°C and 5% CO2.
Passage the cells every 2–3 days with complete CTL medium if expanding further.
Transfer cells to larger cell culture flasks as needed.
Perform microscopic analysis of the cells to confirm T-cell cluster formation.
Take 100,000 electroporated cells and transfer to a polystyrene FACS tube.
Add 2 mL FACS buffer and centrifuge the cells at 480 × g for 5 min at 19°C–22°C.
Decant the supernatant after centrifugation.
Resuspend cell pellet in 100 μL FACS buffer.
Acquire the transfected cells on a flow cytometer and determine the percentage of EGFP+ T cells.
Take 100,000 electroporated cells and transfer them to a polystyrene FACS tube.
Add 2 mL of FACS buffer and centrifuge the cells at 480 × g for 5 min at 19°C–22°C.
Decant the supernatant after centrifugation.
Resuspend cells in 100 μL of FACS buffer.
Stain the cell pellet with 5 μL anti-CD8 FITC, 5 μL anti-TCRαβ PE, and 5 μL anti-CD3 PerCP.
Incubate the cells for 15 min at 19°C–22°C in the dark.
Wash the sample by adding 2 mL of FACS buffer and centrifuge at 480 × g for 5 min at 19°C–22°C.
Discard the supernatant after washing.
Resuspend cell pellet in 100 μL of FACS buffer.
Acquire the stained cells on a flow cytometer.
Determine the percentage of viable CD3+CD8+TCR+ T cells.
